value.rationale: A common ecological beta-diversity dissimilarity mixes total abundance size and community composition, yet is not generally metric. The conditional theorem classifies exactly which prescribed triples of total abundance permit metric failure, with a sharp multiplicative factor and an attaining ecological community. This is a motivated and complete continuous-parameter boundary useful for interpreting raw-count community comparisons, not the known unconditional 1.5 constant or a single arbitrary counterexample.
